description.text: Program Overview Mechanical engineering is the discipline that applies the principles of engineering, physics, and materials science for the design, analysis, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanicalsystems.The engineering field requires an understanding of core concepts including mechanics, kinematics, thermodynamics, materials science, structural analysis, and electricity. ProgramObjectives This program natures advanced engineering and technical personnel having basic knowledge and applied ability in machinery design and manufacture, and being able to work in the first line as to design and manufacture machinary, develop science, apply research, manage operations and other aspects in the fields of mechanical manufacturing. MainCourses Advanced Mathematics, Principle and Applications of Computer, Mechanical Drawing, Engineering Mechanics, Electrical and Electronic Technology, Theory of Machines and Mechanisms, Mechanic, Engineering Control, Electral mechanical integration Technology, Hydraulic Transmission, Mechanical CAD/CAM, Equipment Design, Technology of Mechanical Manufacture, CNC Technology, Single Chip and PLC Technology. Duration Four Years Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Internship Metalworking, mechanical drawing, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, computer measurement and control technology of comprehensive practice, professional practice, professional design, graduation design etc. Future Career Graduates will be capable to work in mechanical and traffic institutions, colleges, companies, focus on various mechanical and electrical products or microelectronic device’s research, design, manufacture, development, administration and so on. Now our graduates are employed extensively in large- and medium-sized manufacturing companies and research institutes. They are involved in mechanical design and manufacturing, technical innovation, applied research, project management, sales and marketing, etc.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at China University of Mining And Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2027 USD/per year ￥ 14600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.A passport photo2.Copy of passport (the photo page) (valid within one year);3.Copy of your final degree transcripts (written in Chinese or English);4.Copy of your final degree certificate (written in Chinese or English);5. Transcripts and degree certificate in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.6.English language proficiency certificate (TOEFL, IELTS or DUOLINGO)7.A physical exam report completed within the last 6 months（Physical Examination Form）；8.A bank statement issued within the last 6 months;9.A non-criminal / background certificate within the last 6 months issued by your home country’s police;

requirements.text: 1.High school certificate.2.Under 25 years old.3.English is a mother tongue,or IELTS score of at least 5.5 or TOEEL score of at least 70, or take part in the online Duolingo English Test.
